SRC-111:R001.text: Future local-GPU roles (log/transcript summarization, SCOUT context preparation, incident clustering, diff triage, recovery-context compression, regression advisory, soak watcher, doc consistency, second review, eventually bounded Work execution) and the resource policy (yield to interactive GPU work, VRAM reserve, visible CPU offload, non-fatal failure, disposable cache), each an experiment adopted one at a time when measured value justifies it
